evidence.notes: Test.testUninstall passes a concrete local UninstallContext to the callback.
The local uninstall context returns the sealed candidate organization Id.
The concrete local uninstall callback implements UninstallHandler.
Test.testUninstall dispatches onUninstall with the local context.

name: core-runtime-local-uninstall-evidence-api67
notes: Deterministic local Test.testUninstall callback only; no hosted Salesforce parity is claimed.
salesforceExclusionReason: Package uninstall callbacks are platform-managed; this fixture proves only Glade's deterministic local Test.testUninstall dispatch and context, with zero hosted Salesforce parity.

source.content: public class CoreRuntimeLocalUninstall implements UninstallHandler { public static Boolean called = false; public void onUninstall(UninstallContext context) { System.assertNotEquals(null, context); Id organizationId = context.organizationId(); System.assertNotEquals(null, organizationId); called = true; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalUninstallTest { @isTest static void dispatchesLocalUninstall() { UninstallHandler handler = new CoreRuntimeLocalUninstall(); Test.testUninstall(handler); System.assert(CoreRuntimeLocalUninstall.called); } }
